name: Strawberry Ice Cream Sandwiches with Banana Waffles & Rainbow Sprinkles

instructions.primary_message: TO MAKE THE WAFFLES: Make sure you have enough space in your freezer to accommodate a baking sheet pan.
Place butter in a small saucepan and melt over medium heat. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, preheat waffle iron according to user's manual.
Place flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dry ingredients and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups all-purpose flour
3 tbsp granulated sugar
2 tsp baking powder
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place banana in a medium bowl and use a potato masher or fork to mash until smooth. Add melted butter, buttermilk, eggs, and vanilla to the bowl, then whisk to combine the wet ingredients. Add to the bowl with the dry ingredients and stir until waffle batter is just combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 banana
1 ¾ cups reduced-fat buttermilk
1 tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, use a ⅓-cup measure (per waffle) to scoop batter into the preheated waffle iron. Close lid and cook until golden and crisp. Transfer to a baking sheet in a single layer.  (Alternatively, use a smaller or larger cup measure to fit your waffle iron's capacity.)
Place waffles in the freezer and chill until frozen, about 2 hours.
TO ASSEMBLE THE SANDWICHES: When the waffles are frozen, remove ice cream from the freezer and set on the counter to soften slightly, 10-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (32 oz) tub strawberry ice cream

instructions.primary_message: When the ice cream has softened, cut the waffles into portions (halves or quarters, depending on the size of your waffles). Set half of the waffles aside, then arrange remaining waffles on a flat surface. Place a scoop of ice cream on top of each, then spread to the edges of the waffle in an even layer. Close sandwiches with remaining waffles, pressing gently to secure. Dip one edge of each sandwich in the sprinkles, then return sandwiches to the baking sheet. Place sandwiches in the freezer and chill until the ice cream is set, about 1 hour.
To serve, arrange ice cream sandwiches on a platter. Allow to soften for about 5 minutes, then share and enjoy!
